notes.title: [Event] My Beautiful Farm Showcase Event
notes.content:
Greetings from Play Together!

🏡A new transformation in Home Town! A Farm has been updated on Kaia Island.
To celebrate this update, an event is being held where Citizens can show off their amazing Farms!

Take a photo of your carefully decorated Farm and upload it on social media with the designated hashtag! 📸
If total participation posts reach 200, all Citizens will receive a special gift. 🎁

Check the notice below for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/84b83bb9288af53c9c554b81002a48d5122ad35f.png[/img]

📅 Event Period
- September 25, 2025, 10:00 AM - October 2, 2025, 00:00 (UTC)

🔎 How to participate
1. Decorate your farm in Home Town.

2. Use [Phone] > [Camera] to snap a photo of your farm.
  TIP. Wear a costume that matches your Farm and take a photo with your character in the Farm to increase your chance of winning.

3. Upload the photo to your personal Facebook, Instagram, or X account with the required hashtags.
- #Playtogether #myfarm #cozygames

4. Submit your game info and SNS post link through the Google Form to complete participation!
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSelrhUxkZQprB9MRLnZ2c6POmKG05hLi2i0oGRLna2wCYH6LQ/viewform?usp=dialog][Google Form Link][/url]

🔔 Steam Version Screenshot Saving Tip!
- The screenshots you’ve taken can be viewed under [Steam] -> [Library] -> [PLAY TOGETHER] -> [POST-GAME SUMMARY].
- You can change the Steam screenshot save location by going to [Steam Icon Right Click] -> [Settings] -> [In Game] -> [Screenshots] -> [Save an external copy of my screenshots].

​🎁 Event Reward
■ Reward for Winners (25 selected by draw)
- 3 Theme Draw Ticket + 3 Seed Pack Vol. 1 + 3 Uncommon Sprinkler

■ Global 200 Posts Reward
-  3 Pumpkin Seed + 1 Gift Ticket

📢 Winner Announcement
- October 22nd

⚠️ Please Note
- If incorrect information is submitted via Google Forms and cannot be verified, you will be excluded from receiving rewards.
- There is no limit to the number of times you can participate, but the participation Reward will only be given once.
- Changing your nickname after participating in the event will disqualify you from receiving rewards. Please make any changes after the reward distribution.
- If you are sanctioned for violating the Terms of Service and Management Policy, you will be excluded from the reward payment.
- Users of the Play Together VNG version cannot participate, and even if you submit a Google Form, you will be excluded from receiving rewards.
- Event rewards will be provided in the form of Coupons, and coupon details will be announced after the event ends.
- Coupons can only be used once per account. Rewards will be sent to your Mailbox.
- Rewards cannot be received after the Mailbox expiration date.
- If rewards are not claimed within the specified timeframe, they will disappear and cannot be recovered.
- The event period and details are subject to change according to company policy. If changes occur, we will provide a separate notice.

We will do our best to ensure you have a great time on Kaia Island. 
Thank you.

notes.title: [Update] September 24th Preview of the Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Home Town has gotten a brand-new makeover!
Discover a special hometown where you can build your very own precious Farm.

▶ Your very own My Farm!
Your very own garden has appeared in your front yard.
Plant and harvest various Crops, and enjoy a rewarding Farm Life.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/666e0fffe59567639c667cd6f70c3d1149cb38d6.jpg[/img]

🧬 Crops may undergo Mutations depending on different conditions.
Mutated Crops can be sold for higher prices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a488301a4c29b0db55e4bcf6c5764db9a5070cb1.jpg[/img]

🤝 The more friends you have, the greater the happiness!
When you’re in the same Farm with friends, Crop selling prices get a bonus. 
You can also gift harvested Crops to your friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/f6588310fb1102bf92059c2f02642666e914401c.png[/img]

▶ A Day at the Farm Event
Events will be held to help you adapt to farming. 
Complete the Event Missions and build up your Farm. 
Depending on your progress, you can earn the ‘Sapling Farmer Costume’ and ‘Choco Mottled Cow.’
※ A Day at the Farm Event Missions can be completed for 21 days starting from your first login after the update.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/86e2f051b4c106446d7377b0591f9f1a59b1dab6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7684178c40981691dc870b6001cb0a28e80939a7.png[/img]

▶ Healthy Growth Attendance
A new attendance board has been added! Simply log in for 14 days to get the ‘Exceptional Sprinkler,’ which helps your Crops grow, and a ‘Seed Pack Vol. 1’ full of different Seeds.
You can claim attendance rewards by stamping at the ‘Event’ icon on the top right of the game screen.
※ The Healthy Growth Attendance event runs for 21 days from when you first claim a reward.
※ Note: If you don’t stamp the reward, you won’t be able to claim it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/2928ef7605b9e3beccd54ce7cf1bff94dade94c3.png[/img]

▶ Introducing the Star Minime Carrier!
The Star Minime Carrier has been added, letting your Minime join you in various activities.
Now you don’t need to place your Minime on the cold ground while fishing, riding a Vehicle, Mining, or using Critter! 
Check out the new Star Minime Carrier at the Minime Center.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/26ae3520bd7831daac9075f2a40c03a9706d67b1.png[/img]

▶ Show Affection to Minimes
Show Affection to other players’ Minimes.
Loved Minimes get a small boost in random Stats.
※ Stat boosts apply only up to a certain number of times per day, and Minime EXP does not increase.

▶ Moo Moo~ Pudgy Cow Draw!
New friends have arrived to wake the farm in the morning—‘Pudgy Cow’ is here!
Travel all around Kaia Island with Pudgy Cow!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/fdaa83889c05d870eed018c4882184e8e682584e.png[/img]

▶ Shining Letters, Hangeul Day!
‘Sejong the Great’ and the ‘Hangeul Lovers Member’ NPCs will appear in the plaza.
Check out special costumes engraved with beautiful Hangeul and Taegukgi items!
※ Available from October 3, 2025, 00:00 - October 10, 2025, 12:00 AM (UTC).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/f797caef1db04dd2a5c612d68461242d67d44664.png[/img]

▶ Other Updates and Changes
- Other UI and convenience features will be enhanced.
- Some in-game error phenomena will be fixed.
 
※ Please Note
- Update schedule details to be announced separately.
- The update details and improvements are not finalized. Changes or additions may happen, and a separate notice will be posted if this is the case.
- The screenshots used for the update note were taken during the development phase. Details may vary in the actual update.
 
We hope your time on Kaia Island is enjoyable.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Update] September 10th Preview of the Upcoming Update
notes.content:
The Cat organization has launched an attack to dominate humanity.
Fight against the invasion of the Cat Legion!

▶ A Giant Cat Robot appears in the city?!
The massive Meowminator is destroying the city by swinging its giant claws and shooting lasers from its eyes!
Follow the orders of the brave Director Bark and fight against the Cat organization.
※ By defeating the Meowminator, you can obtain Meowminator Coins, which can be used in the minigame Nya Nya! Giant Cat Dozer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/e6a7e7486a16e4eca109a7bed2ff65b747813fee.jpg[/img]

Be on guard!
The L-Class Meowminator performs powerful attacks such as ‘Claw Slash’, ‘Laser Eyes’, and ‘High Jump’.
Dodge swiftly and prove yourself as the top Special Agent.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a5fbc913b35ae7afec7b5a079155f108991064a7.jpg[/img]

▶ Nya Nya! Giant Cat Dozer
In the minigame screen, tap the spots you want to drop the Meowminator Coins.
- If the Dozer pushes the stacked coins into the center area, you can collect Meowminator Points.
- Use the collected points to earn various rewards, including the L-Class Meowminator mount and P.A.W.S. Agent costumes!
- There are also special coins that help you progress in the minigame. Please check the (?) button in-game for details.
※ Meowminator Coins can be obtained until the maintenance on September 24, 2025 (UTC).
※ The Nya Nya! Giant Cat Dozer minigame is available until September 26, 2025, 00:00 (UTC).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7820a8110fb88edddd1af4e84e288e487d2cad1e.gif[/img]

▶ P.A.W.S. Promotional Test
Defeat the Meowminator, advance as a higher-ranked agent, and protect the peace of Kaia Island.
Rewards will be given based on your battle performance, including P.A.W.S. Agent costumes for Minime and the Fluffy Puppy Tail.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/8ae0f727b96b3a3080c0f4d545da9c047992c7e0.png[/img]

▶ Cat Attack Attendance
The attendance event begins where you can obtain the Moist Puppy Nose and Perky Puppy Ears simply by logging in for 7 days!
If you don’t stamp your attendance after logging in, you cannot receive the rewards.
Please tap the Event icon at the top right of the game screen to claim your rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a86b4414d036d4869fec450ec43de2beb092661b.jpg[/img]

▶ Werewolf City Draw!
Try on the chic Werewolf costume and equip the Neo Wolf Gun.
Ride the Neo Wolf Bike to race through the dark city streets!
※ Depending on the number of Themed Draws, you can earn Special Rewards in the event Themed Draw.
However, if you participate in the Themed Draw through Daily Deals or other benefits, the Special Reward points will not accumulate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/056233e533081da9f77a9accb14aa2d91d3e6daf.png[/img]

▶ Other Additions/Changes
- Some in-game errors have been fixed.

※ Please Note
- Update schedule details to be announced separately.
- The update details and improvements are not finalized. Changes or additions may happen, and a separate notice will be posted if this is the case.
- The screenshots used for the update note were taken during the development phase. Details may vary in the actual update.
 
We hope your time on Kaia Island is enjoyable.
Thank you.

notes.title: [Update] July 2 Preview of the Upcoming Update (7/3 3:30 Correction)
notes.content:
Dinosaurs have appeared on Kaia Island!
Join the research team to explore the Dinosaur Park and help restore the dinosaurs!

▶ Dinosaur Park
The Camping Ground on Kaia Island has transformed into a massive Dinosaur Park!
Special ore veins and dinosaur traces have been discovered throughout the newly changed Dinosaur Park, prompting Owen and the research team to launch the Dino Restoration Project.
By Mining these special ore veins, you can obtain Tyranno Coins or dinosaur Fossils, which can be used to craft various Items in the Minigames "Push! Dino Dozer!" and "Tino's Workshop."
Lend a hand to Owen and the team in the restoration efforts, and bring the Velociraptor back to life as you explore Kaia Island together!
※ Aside from the Minigames, features like NPCs and the Dinosaur Upgrade Device in the Dinosaur Park will remain available regardless of the Event period.
※ Dinosaur Fossils can only be obtained through Mining within the Dinosaur Park.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/00122e83d1a730232784de955cc09c97ca581773.png[/img]

▶ Dino Restoration Project
To open the Dinosaur Park, we need dinosaurs!
Use bones obtained through Mining to create a Velociraptor and complete your Illustrated Book!
Create and hatch a Velociraptor Egg to get Tyranno Coins and Dino Stamps!
Collect all Dino Stamps to receive a special Costume~
Complete the Dino Restoration Project to earn the Baby Dino Costume and the Dino Restorer Name Tag!
※ Tyranno Coins can be used in the Minigame “Push! Dino Dozer!”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/0aa5e02b5760807b413d64931d7e9e6702800350.png[/img]

▶ Minigame “Push! Dino Dozer!”
Use Tyranno Coins to push the Dino Dozer and win the Baby Dino Profile and the Tyrannosaurus Pet!
In the Minigame screen, tap where you want to drop the Tyranno Coin. Each time you drop a coin, it stacks up.
As you push the Dino Dozer with stacked coins, some will fall, earning you Tyranno Points equal to the number of coins dropped.
There are special coins that help you push the Dino Dozer more effectively, so check the Minigame in-game for more details on coin types and the Event!
※ Tyranno Coins can still be obtained from ore veins in the Dinosaur Park after the Event ends and can be used as Crafting Material for various Items.
※ The Minigame “Push! Dino Dozer!” will be available until 16 July 2025 23:59 (UTC).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/f2c78f287e1c9255757ea77e240d249f64e1e0d4.png[/img]

▶ Tino's Workshop! Velociraptor Egg Now Available!
Collect Items such as Dinosaur Bones, Dinosaur DNA Capsule, and Dinosaur Research Data through Mining and use them in Tino's Workshop to craft a variety of Items.
You can find dinosaur-related Items in Tino's Workshop, such as the Velociraptor Egg, Dino Supplements, and the Large T-Rex Figure!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/0954d78980e81edc31c1fbeb304ac69100e8b803.png[/img]

▶ Let’s Upgrade Your Dinosaur!
Visit the NPC Rexton in the Dinosaur Park and use the Dinosaur Upgrade Device!
By using a Velociraptor Pet as an upgrade Ingredient, you can strengthen it into a higher-grade Velociraptor Pet, and with enough upgrades, you'll even be able to craft the powerful Mecha Velociraptor.
From a stylish, personalized Velociraptor to a cool and mighty Mecha Velociraptor, discover them all through the Dinosaur Upgrade Device!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/112703cee1ae129791b26d236e13fd9ae9bc12f9.png[/img]

▶ Dino Fossil Attendance
The Dino Fossil Attendance event has begun, where you can receive the Horned Dinosaur Skull Helmet and life4cuts Booth (Jungle) just by logging in for 7 days!
Even if you log into the game, you cannot receive rewards unless you stamp your attendance. Be sure to touch the 'Event' icon in the top-right corner of the game screen to collect your rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/6afeb02767ebbfef45bf52ab04fed0e04ac80196.png[/img]

▶ Take Better Care of Your Minime!
Seven new Minime Room options are now available to support your Minime’s growth.
Each room offers activities that enhance your Minime’s Sociability, Charm, Luck, Morality, and other Attribute stats.
Additionally, new Job choices have been introduced and the Upgrade process has been improved, making it easier to train your Minime into a more distinctive and charming character!
Grow your very own Minime in style with the upgraded system!
※ The Minime Room will be added on July 6, 2025 00:00 (UTC).
※ Minime Room options are available at any time via the Furniture Shop – Menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a03a127b81fb8ed9987074ba9cae6d887092ca85.png[/img]

▶ No Worries If You Failed the Upgrade! Add PlayBoo V2 & PlayBoo Point System!
We’ve added the adorable PlayBoo V2 products along with a new PlayBoo Point system that rewards you with points when you Failed upgrades.
When a PlayBoo upgrade fails, you earn points that can be used to purchase new PlayBoos!
Also, PlayBoo V2 comes in a special size that’s 200% larger than before, and you can buy one once per day at a 50% Sale from NPC Bellunah!
Collect your cute PlayBoo keyrings and even get special display stands using the PlayBoo V2 and PlayBoo Point system!
※ Available from July 10, 2025 00:00 (UTC).
※ PlayBoo V2 can be purchased at the Shop or from NPC Bellunah in the Plaza.
※ PlayBoo Point can be used at the PlayBoo Point Shop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/d9c5a5337ea5b5949d8bc9e984283dbbd59fe3f3.png[/img]

▶ Other Updates and Changes
- Other UI and convenience features will be enhanced.
- Some in-game error phenomena will be fixed.
 
※ Please Note
- Update schedule details to be announced separately.
- The update details and improvements are not finalized. Changes or additions may happen, and a separate notice will be posted if this is the case.
- The screenshots used for the update note were taken during the development phase. Details may vary in the actual update.

notes.content:
Meet the monstrous deep sea fish and the wrecked Majesty ship!
Help Captain Marcus and obtain the Legendary Sword Fishing Rod to catch the monstrous deep sea fish!

▶ Monstrous Deep Sea Fish and the Legendary Sword Fishing Rod
A legendary monstrous deep-sea fish has appeared in the waters around Kaia Island!
The deep-sea monster fish is gigantic and powerful, creating whirlpools, so look for those whirlpools!
Also, by crafting the ‘Legendary Sword Fishing Rod’ and the ‘Fish Finder’ at Damandra’s Workshop, you can receive help with fishing!
*What is a Fish Finder? A machine that guides you to areas where specific types of fish are more likely to appear.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/b5fd160aa85891388b1403b1ed79ab8e8ee17916.png[/img]

▶ Majesty Ship Log!
Help Captain Marcus complete various missions and fill out the Majesty Ship Log!
You can earn ‘Golden Compasses’ every time you complete a mission.
*Golden Compasses can also be earned from the supply boxes you catch while fishing.
*Use the Golden Compass to play the mini-game ‘Find the Treasure of the Sea!’ and search for the ‘Hidden Treasure of the Sea!’
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/9ba4e8ae867a5c361eac362610da91a775e932a2.png[/img]

▶ Find the Treasure of the Sea! Mini-game
Use the ‘Golden Compass’ to find the hidden ‘Treasure of the Sea’ and earn the ‘Great Captain Costume’ and the ‘Majesty Ship’ mount!
You can open one of the 16 available slots, and it will continue until all treasures are found.
If you discover a trap, the game will end, and you will receive the ‘Treasures of the Sea’ you have found so far.
*The ‘Golden Compass’ is available until the maintenance on July 3, 2025 (Thursday).
*The Find the Treasure of the Sea! mini-game is available until July 4, 2025 00:00 (UTC).
*If you have many Golden Compasses, you can set a multiplier of up to 100x, which will allow you to collect multiple ‘Treasures of the Sea’ according to your multiplier.
*At the start of the game, there is a chance for the Mega Chance to activate, and you will receive additional ‘Treasures of the Sea’ based on the Mega Chance multiplier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/42683ad87bb936b74c008bc05c3d13edd7ec6f29.png[/img]

▶ Ocean Exploration Attendance
The Ocean Exploration Attendance event will start, and you can earn a ‘Fish Finder LS-001’ and a Golden Compass just by logging in for 7 days!
Make sure to stamp your attendance and head out to find the hidden treasures of the sea!
*You must touch the ‘Event’ icon on the top right of the game screen to claim your rewards, or you will not receive them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/582004862212629b3164bbe6d4f9a9da095a263f.png[/img]

▶ New Card Collection ‘Dreams and Reality’!
A new card collection event, ‘Dreams and Reality,’ will start.
Collect cards from the themes of daily life and dreamland/nightmares that unfold in Kaia Island's school, and receive generous rewards like the ‘Dreamer’ name tag!
*The new card collection event runs from [June 15, 2025 00:00 - Aug, 09 2025 23:59 (UTC)].
*All collected cards will be reset after the event ends.
*To ensure safe application of the ‘Dreams and Reality’ card collection data, the receipt of card packs will be temporarily restricted for 1 minute before and after the event switch. Card packs obtained through collecting will be stored in your inbox.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/8ff3e82b743df17968dbecaaafad92f98a7b8a81.png[/img]

▶ Rabbit Studio Draw!
Hoppity hop! The Rabbit Studio Draw will go live on Kaia Island!
Fly around Kaia Island riding the ‘Flying Bunny Bot!’ When you board, you’ll transform into a cute little rabbit!
*Event themed draws will take place based on the number of draws you make, and you can earn ‘Special Rewards’ through these event draws.
However, if you proceed with themed draws through daily deals or other benefits, special reward points will not accumulate.
*It will be added on [June 12, 2025 00:00 (UTC)].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/9fdd9fdfae389303269a96ad884b51c54f1069c9.png[/img]

▶ Other Updates and Changes
- The Sanrio characters collaboration is ending.
: For more details, refer to the [[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3198850/view/530973947986969277?l=english]collaboration ending notice link[/url]]!
- To make life on Kaia Island more comfortable, the number and difficulty of daily missions will be slightly revamped.

- The ability to summon boats in freshwater areas will be removed.
- A bug where large pets could be stored in the Dreamland Pet Fence has been fixed.

- The description text for some products has been updated.

- The update details and improvements are not finalized. Changes or additions may happen, and a separate notice will be posted if this is the case.
- The screenshots used for the update note were taken during the development phase. Details may vary in the actual update.

notes.title: [Update] April 28th Preview of the Upcoming Update
notes.content:
The beautiful Dreamland is being tainted by nightmares!
Defeat the Nightmare Monsters and restore Dreamland to its original form!

▶ Defeat the Nightmare Monsters!
Receive the 'Dream Gun Weapon' from Dreamy, defeat the Nightmare Monsters, and save Dreamland from being consumed by nightmares!
Each time you defeat a monster, you can obtain 'Essence of Nightmares.' Complete the Nightmare Record Mission by defeating monsters! You can also obtain the 'Bed Consumed by Nightmares' mount, where terrifying nightmare hands emerge.
※ The 'Essence of Nightmares' you collect can be used in the mini-game 'Gather Fragments of Memory.'
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/00d50cc21922cbf0a764ef1fe6bbd3d6b9d4e46e.png[/img]

▶ Mini-game 'Gather Fragments of Memory'
Use the 'Essence of Nightmares' to open the Nightmare Drawer and collect 'Fragments of Memory' in this mini-game, available only during the Nightmare event!
The Nightmare Drawer consists of 8 rows, and you can open one of the 4 drawers in each row.
If you open a drawer with a Fragments of Memory, you can move to the next row. If you open an empty drawer, the mini-game ends, and you will collect the Fragments of Memory you have opened so far. Be careful when choosing, as the number of drawers with Fragments of Memory decreases as you go higher!
※ The 'Essence of Nightmares' can be collected until May 21, 2025, before maintenance.
※ The 'Gather Fragments of Memory' mini-game is available until May 23, 2025 00:00 (UTC)
※ By collecting Fragments of Memory, you can obtain the 'Gothic Fluffy Hair' and the 'Nightmare Girl Dress.'
※ If you have a large number of 'Essence of Nightmares,' you can set the multiplier up to 100x, allowing you to collect Fragments of Memory in bulk based on the multiplier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7c186f35b2a46961aaa6c16a0c14e0b0154c0c72.png[/img]

▶ Dreamland Workshop – Nightmare Edition!
Craft new furniture with the 'Essence of Nightmares' obtained from defeating Nightmare Monsters.
Come and meet gothic-style furniture and the adorable 'Nightmare Sheep' at Dreamland Workshop!

# You can also craft existing Dreamland Workshop furniture and Sheep Eggs.
※ Capture the Nightmare Fish and Nightmare Insects from Dreamland and exchange them for 'Dreamland Coins' with 'Siestalina' and 'Slumbert.'
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/ca2b625a2486b16b4064a463a6fec0f7743e4882.png[/img]

▶ Traces of Nightmares Attendance
An attendance event has begun where you can receive special rewards by attending for 7 days.
Receive the 'Mask of Nightmares' and 'Guiding Candle' rewards and escape from the nightmares!
※ Even if you log into the game, you cannot receive rewards unless you stamp your attendance. Be sure to touch the 'Event' icon in the top-right corner of the game screen to collect your rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/fff6cecb8694f733c63bf1f5dcee145d6de13d43.png[/img]

▶ Nightmare? That's Me, Queen of the Night Draw!
A new Queen of the Night Draw, colored by nightmares, has been added.
Gift monsters the 'Scepter of the Night' weapon, infused with the Queen's power, and send them into nightmares!
※ An event-themed draw is available, where you can obtain 'Special Rewards' based on your draw count.
However, special reward points will not accumulate if the themed draw was performed through special offers such as daily specials.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/6987842ccc3a5b8e880a431b9bfd79a49b2b6594.png[/img]

▶ Set a Fish Trap to Catch Fish!
Did you know you can set a fish trap in places like the Plaza, Resort, and Dreamland on Kaia Island?
Find the [Fish Trap] right now on your [Phone]!
The time and quantity of fish you can catch depend on the trap size, and you can increase the chances of catching rare fish by using bait.
※ Fish traps are unlocked after catching 10 fish with fishing.
※ Only one fish trap can be set, but the number of traps that can be installed increases once you reach 50 entries in the Fish Book.
※ You can set an additional fish trap when activating Plus Membership.
※ Traps that are set can be retrieved at any time, and you can only collect the fish caught at the time of retrieval.
※ You can complete the installation of a fish trap immediately by using gems.
※ The bait used and the trap are consumed immediately upon installation.
※ Fish traps set in Dreamland will be discarded when the Dreamland event ends, so don't forget to retrieve them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/69322e70f2621539af3d7cc5b2311afa591ae820.png[/img]

▶ New Card Collection 'Our Episode'
A new card collection event featuring episodes from the NPCs of Kaia Island begins!
Collect cards and receive generous rewards, including the 'Top Citizen' name tag and 'Play Together Hot Air Balloon'!
※ When the new card collection event starts, all previously collected card information will be reset.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/7c1210996edc133290161cfbfc8527c790f60add.png[/img]

▶ Report Improvements
No to illegal programs! No to bad manners! Please report any disruptive residents who disturb Kaia Island! The reporting system has been improved to make reporting easier and more efficient!
If you spot a bad resident, be sure to use the newly revamped reporting system!

# Reporting Illegal Programs

April Fools' Day is taken over by the prank fairy Aiden!
Wait... April Fools' Day is over already!? Oh well, it's a belated April Fools' prank!
[previewyoutube=2K0JSq2uY6M;full][/previewyoutube]
▶ Aiden's Belated April Fools' Day?!
Kaia Island has been swept up in all sorts of pranks due to Aiden's magic!
Help Mr. Terry and Ms. Mys restore Kaia Island to its original state and collect Fairy Coins!
Fairy Coins can be used in the ‘Haywire Candy Machine,’ and by collecting Candy Drops from the machine, you can obtain various items like Mischievous Fairy Wings (Vehicle) and Mischievous Fairy Outfit!
※ Fairy Coins can also be purchased in the Event Coin Shop and can be earned from ‘Fairy's Pouch’ via fishing during the event period.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/520275e9cd681e093df206535bafca4ab0c18aab.jpg[/img]

# What is the Haywire Candy Machine?
The Haywire Candy Machine is a mini-game that can only be played by using Fairy Coins during the event period!
※ In the candy machine game, the candy passes through obstacles and falls, and the number of Candy Drops you receive depends on the final landing number.
※ If you have many Fairy Coins, you can set a multiplier, and receive additional Candy Drops based on the multiplier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/32baebfa4f65e76e28ae21d3cb312e078b42df37.jpg[/img]

A new attendance event begins where you can receive special rewards just by attending for 7 days!
Receive Aiden’s masterpiece ‘Magical Paint’ and paint Kaia Island in blotchy colors!
If you don’t stamp your attendance in the ‘Attendance’ book, you won’t receive the rewards, so be sure to touch the ‘Event’ icon in the top-right corner of the game screen to collect your rewards!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/2d03990f6f576dcd272ffb9585db16b1f686a3fb.jpg[/img]

Newly added to the game is the "Pompompurin Draw."
Get in the adorable "Pompompurin Hot Air Balloon" and drift through the skies of Kaia Island! It'll be like traveling with the one and only Pompompurin!
Also, try setting up the Pompompurin Cafe at your house with the gigantic "Pompompurin Mega Doll" and the many furniture pieces!
※ The "Pompompurin Draw" can only be used with the "Pompompurin Draw Ticket" item.
※ The "Pompompurin Draw" can be found under [Shop] -> [Collaboration] -> [Sanrio characters].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/be04bad12ede0a1ec4ac77f192d10666bbfefbf3.jpg[/img]

▶ Congratulations on the 4th Anniversary!
A new NPC, ‘Connie Gratz,’ has appeared to celebrate PLAY TOGETHER's 4th anniversary in the Plaza!
Celebrate the 4th anniversary with Connie Gratz and receive the ‘4th Anniversary Celebration Hat’!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/6a0b36406d9abdf1c78e1dfe8db60c4d743a9174.jpg[/img]

▶ Cute Keychain Doll ‘PlayBoo’ Added
Various small and cute keychain dolls with different expressions and concepts, ‘PlayBoo,’ are now available.
Purchase ‘PlayBoo’ from the NPC Bellunah in the Plaza!
Collect different ‘PlayBoo’ from each theme to receive a PlayBoo Display Stand.
※ You can wear PlayBoo like a keychain or store it on the PlayBoo Display Stand.
※ PlayBoo can be enhanced to become bigger and cuter.
※ Will be added on April 10, 2025 00:00 (UTC).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/aecec54ee144350cc6be7f67c69ba4e372196209.jpg[/img]

▶ Season Pass Rewards Update
From the next season pass, the rewards for ‘FREE PASS’ and ‘PLAY PASS activation’ will be improved, including gems and card packs.
※ After activating the PLAY PASS, achieving tiers will guarantee ‘Gold Cards.’
※ This update will apply starting from the season pass set to begin on April 12, 2025.

- A new NPC selling ‘Long-Tailed Tit Eggs’ will be added to the Camping Ground.
: The location of Grossard will move next to Dr. Farbe.
- A new theme for the Home Party, ‘Housewarming,’ will be added.
- The profile photo capture feature will be improved.
: You can now rotate your character to take pictures in any direction.

notes.content:
Urgent Transmission: Call from the KSIA Director!
The Shadowy Syndicate has appeared on Kaia Island.
All agents are requested to gather at Kaia Island and counter the Shadowy Syndicate.
[previewyoutube=hu2ya6E9S3I;full][/previewyoutube]
▶ [Operation: Target Takedown Report]
Top secret orders have been issued to eliminate Shadow Monsters.
Visit Paperman and Black Rose to obtain the "Spy's Pistol" weapon, then take down the Shadow Monsters that have taken over Kaia Island!
You can earn various rewards, including Name Tags, from "Rookie Agent" to "HQ Commander".
By defeating a certain number of Shadow Monsters, you can obtain the "Shadow Monster Suit," which makes infiltration easier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/be2f238cbb92cbdd181c5d6f34f8fd6ce6256f14.jpg[/img]

▶ Collect the Spy Cards!
Emergency orders have been issued to recover Spy Cards.
Complete various missions, including finding the hidden marks of the Shadow Syndicate, and collect Spy Cards!
Collecting Spy Cards will allow you to disguise yourself as a perfect spy with the "Sculpted Spy Hair" and "Spy Suit".
※ You can check the secret missions by tapping the + icon on the event page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/24d14bdf746534892ac7ad1a3b342d3ceb788c87.jpg[/img]

▶ Covert Mission Attendance
A special attendance event has started where you can receive special rewards just by checking in for 7 days!
Don’t miss out on the "Special Spy Watch" and "Spy Gear Bag," which seem ordinary but hide advanced technology!
You must touch the "Event" icon at the top right of the game screen to receive rewards. If you don’t stamp your attendance, you won't receive the rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/a39cf8c7ae9cf5d5f3648ae7a565ac08b15b445f.jpg[/img]

▶ Black Rose Draw!
The professional spy, "Black Rose," who disarms her enemies with her beauty!
Now, you can meet her at the "Black Rose Draw."
With the "Black Spy Gun" and "Black Spy Convertible," any spy mission will be a piece of cake!
※ A themed event draw will take place, where you can earn "Special Rewards" based on the number of draws.
However, special reward points are not accumulated if you perform draws via other discounts or offers.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/ab0d39af52143b91d25e0e10bfc135b97c6e597e.jpg[/img]

▶ New Card Collection "Kaia Island Encyclopedia"!
A new card collection event, "Kaia Island Encyclopedia," has begun.
Spring is for outings! Collect various themes and receive generous rewards such as the "Astute Face" and "Dr. Know-It-All" name tags while pondering where to go and which restaurants to visit!
※ All previously collected card data will be reset when the new card collection event begins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/eb1f1cb67476bb6ec69a66c51d436837a3ae424d.jpg[/img]

▶ Illustrated Book UI Improvements
To improve the usability of the Illustrated Book, the following UI updates will be made.
1. A main page for the Illustrated Book will be added.
- A main page that allows you to see the progress of the Illustrated Book and Collection at a glance will be added.
- The main page will display the main tabs for 'Pet Collection', 'Critter Collection', 'Fish Book', 'Fossil Collection', and 'Collection'.
- By selecting a main tab, you will be redirected to the corresponding Illustrated Book or Collection page.
2. Sub-tabs will be added within the Illustrated Book.
- Each Illustrated Book will be organized into sub-tabs to make it easier to check the information.
- For the Fishing Book, a 'Fishing White Paper' will be added at the top of the UI, where you can view fishing-related guides.
3. The Collection UI will be improved.
- The Collection's representative icon and achievement gauge will be added, allowing you to easily distinguish the Collection and see the progress.
- Filters for 'View All', 'In Progress', and 'Completed' will be added, making it easier to view the Collection list based on its status.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/665a283ba5563eb542fc6ce802ca1d554d65028d.jpg[/img]

▶ Club Usability Improvements
The following usability improvements will be made to the Club.
1. A public/private option will be added when creating a Club.
- If public is selected, the Club will be displayed in the Club list.
- If private is selected, the Club will not be displayed in the Club list, and membership will be by invitation only.
※ Existing Clubs will have their visibility set based on the membership method.
2. The number of Clubs you can join and the number of Club members will be increased.
- The number of Clubs you can join will increase from 1 to 3.
- The number of Club members will increase from 60 to 100.
- The number of selectable tags will increase from 3 to 10.
3. An icon to change the Club's photo will be added.
4. A 'Club' menu will be added to the Profile page.
5. A function to set the language tag used in the Club will be added.

▶ Other Updates and Changes
- The Event Home will be divided into 'Limited' and 'Constant' event tabs based on the type of event.
- When crafting Beaver and Pink Beaver pets from Gandalpink, new recipes will be added that use regular Beaver and Pink Beaver Fish.
- Other UI and convenience features will be enhanced.
- Some in-game error phenomena will be fixed.

※ Please Note
- Update schedule details to be announced separately.
- The update details and improvements are not finalized. Changes or additions may happen, and a separate notice will be posted if this is the case.
- The screenshots used for the update note were taken during the development phase. Details may vary in the actual update.

We hope your time on Kaia Island is enjoyable.
Thank you.

notes.content:
Greetings from Play Together!

Clap clap clap! Finally! The long-awaited Steam version of PLAY TOGETHER is now open!
To celebrate the official Steam launch, the “Earn a Special Nameplate” Event is about to begin!
Don’t miss this amazing chance to get Gems and the Steampunk Nameplate just by logging into Steam!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322439/25534a3cb2a9201240dc90a3c72b18d6b48b3133.png[/img]

Haven’t linked your account yet?
If not, link your account on Steam and claim your rewards!

Check out the details below.

📅 Event Period
- January 14, 2025 02:00 ~ February 16, 2025 23:59 (UTC)

📃 How to Participate
[For Existing Users]
- Link your existing PLAY TOGETHER account to Steam and access PLAY TOGETHER via Steam.
※ Please check the [url=youtu.be/HUfv_7B-ALI][Steam Link Guide][/url] for instructions on linking your account.
※ Guest accounts are excluded from participating in the Event.

[For New Users]
- Simply access PLAY TOGETHER via Steam!

🎁 Event Rewards
- 300 Gems
- 20,000 Stars
- STEAMPUNK (Name Tag)
※ Rewards will be provided as a coupon, redeemable only when running PLAY TOGETHER on Steam.

📝 Coupon Code
- PTINTHESTEAM

※ Important Notes
- Event rewards will be distributed only to new Steam accounts or accounts linked to Steam after entering the coupon code.
- Event rewards will be sent to your in-game mailbox. If not claimed before the expiration period, they will become unavailable.
- Unclaimed rewards will expire after the mailbox period, and additional assistance cannot be provided.

We will do our best to ensure you have an enjoyable time on Kaia Island.
Thank you.

*Posting Date: 2025-01-14 (UTC+9)
